baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَدْ فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَٰنِكُمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: A delimited obligation is paired with an instituted way of undoing its bond. The oath remains consequential, but its force can be converted through a governed discharge whose limits are known and corrective.

activation_trace.role: The literal imposition of a known limit makes the discharge a specified procedure rather than an unbounded permission.
The literal discharge of an oath supplies the operative legal transition out of self-binding speech.
The literal loosening of a knot renders the oath as a bond that is opened in an ordered way.
The literal oath identifies the binding speech whose force the procedure addresses.
The literal administration of an affair places the release under continuing divine governance.
The literal disclosure of a matter to the knower grounds the procedure in full awareness of motive and consequence.
The literal restraint that restores order keeps release corrective rather than evasive.

changed_reading.before: God permits people to break their oaths.
changed_reading.after: God has already instituted a measured discharge for self-binding oaths: obligation is converted accountably, not casually ignored.

baseline_models.mechanism: The verse can be pictured materially as a cut boundary with a controlled opening. Oath-force is not smashed; a precise outlet is cut, the knot is loosened, and a bridle keeps the released force directed.

activation_trace.role: The literal incision supplies the boundary-making cut from which the controlled outlet begins.
The literal opening at an edge turns prescription into an authorized passage through a binding limit.
The literal untying makes the passage operate by loosening rather than violent rupture.
The literal force and right carried by the oath becomes the pressure that must be redirected.
The literal bridle supplies the regulating device that prevents release from becoming loss of control.

changed_reading.before: The verse announces an exception to an oath.
changed_reading.after: The verse diagrams a relief channel cut into obligation itself: force exits through a governed aperture while the boundary remains meaningful.

baseline_models.mechanism: An oath creates a claim over future action, but the nearest and most entitled governor of that action is God. The discharge therefore transfers the affair back from self-made compulsion to primary jurisdiction.

activation_trace.role: The literal oath supplies the humanly uttered claim over future conduct.
The literal nearness without an intervening gap makes divine patronage immediate rather than merely consoling.
The literal taking charge of an affair assigns ultimate administration of the oath to God.
The literal priority and entitlement marks divine governance as the claim that outranks a self-imposed one.
The literal adjudication between claims gives the transfer a juridical mechanism.

changed_reading.before: God protects those who use the dispensation.
changed_reading.after: God is the nearest and rightful administrator of obligation, so release is a return to primary jurisdiction rather than autonomous self-exemption.

baseline_models.mechanism: The named taḥilla can denote a determinate act sufficient to cross a threshold. The verse thus holds together release and performance: the bond ends through a measured response, not through bare retraction.

activation_trace.role: The literal fixed limit supplies the threshold that the discharge must satisfy.
The literal oath-discharge, including a limited performed act, makes release procedurally embodied.
The literal sworn bond is the state changed by crossing the performative threshold.
The literal exactness and secure construction makes the threshold calibrated rather than symbolic hand-waving.

changed_reading.before: Release is the mental cancellation of a prior promise.
changed_reading.after: Release is a performed transition with a divinely measured sufficiency: a bounded act changes the oath's legal state.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence identifies the practical problem behind the oath: something divinely made lawful is self-forbidden while another person's approval is sought. The prescribed discharge reverses that unauthorized hardening, while covering and mercy absorb the relational damage of reversal.

activation_trace.role: The literal fixed obligation makes the remedy authoritative enough to counter a self-imposed prohibition.
The literal oath-discharge is the focus mechanism that repairs the preceding self-binding act.
The literal oath supplies the inferred bridge between self-prohibition and its prescribed reversal.
The literal prohibition supplies the hardened state that the focus discharge must undo.
The literal lifting of prohibition establishes divine permission as the state to be restored.
The literal pursuit of an object turns spousal approval into the motive exerting pressure on the oath.
The literal attempt to gain another's approval identifies appeasement as the relational force behind self-restriction.
The literal marital pair locates the pressure inside an intimate bond rather than an abstract legal case.
The literal covering of fault supplies protection from the aftereffects of correcting the oath.
The literal tenderness makes the correction relationally reparative rather than merely technical.

structural_cues: 66:1 immediately orders self-prohibition, divine permission, sought spousal approval, then forgiveness and mercy before 66:2 names oath-discharge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibition versus permission, pursuit of spousal approval, and a merciful close; I infer that the oath operationalizes the self-prohibition and that taḥilla repairs both normative and relational distortion. A live alternative is a narrower expiation rule with no general account of appeasement.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives a generic rule for escaping any oath.
changed_reading.after: Here the discharge corrects a relationally motivated act of making the lawful forbidden, restoring divine permission without denying the damage caused by appeasement.

context_deltas.mechanism: A concealed utterance is leaked, exposed, and then handled selectively: part is identified and part is passed over. This sequence makes the focus close 'knowing, wise' operational; knowledge detects the speech event, while wisdom restrains how much is surfaced during repair.

activation_trace.role: The literal oath anchors the model in consequential speech rather than disclosure as an independent theme.
The literal knowing of what is otherwise hidden supplies detection of the oath's motive and effects.
The literal restraint for repair supplies the selective limit on disclosure.
The literal concealment in the interior establishes the information initially held under cover.
The repeated literal partitioning makes partial disclosure, not total exposure, the controlling pattern.
The literal emergence into visibility supplies the movement from secret speech to accountable fact.
The literal discrimination by a trace supplies precise identification of only what repair requires.
The literal turning aside supplies deliberate non-disclosure as an active form of restraint.
The repeated literal knowing explicitly links the disclosure episode back to the focus epithet.
The literal knowledge of an affair's interior deepens the distinction between knowing all and revealing all.

structural_cues: 66:3 repeats 'some' three times and pairs exposure with an explicit act of turning aside from some material.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, leakage, exposure, partition, recognition, overlooking, and reiterated knowledge; I infer that this is a worked example of the knowing restraint named in 66:2 and that such restraint calibrates oath repair. The live alternative is that the disclosure episode is adjacent narrative rather than a model for discharge.

changed_reading.before: 'Knowing, wise' is a general divine signature after the legal rule.
changed_reading.after: The signature describes selective information governance: the oath is discharged under knowledge that can expose everything and wisdom that reveals only what repair needs.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearts incline and two people can back one another, but that local coalition is answered by a wider alignment centered on God as patron. The focus declaration 'God is your mawla' therefore governs competing loyalties: oath-discharge can detach action from intimate coalition pressure and return allegiance to its primary center.

activation_trace.role: The literal force and claim of the oath supplies the leverage by which a local allegiance can control conduct.
The literal taking charge of an affair makes divine patronage the governing center of the realignment.
The literal inclination of heart and loyalty supplies the affective tilt from which coalition pressure grows.
The literal heart locates the alliance shift inside volition, not only in external conduct.
The repeated literal backing and support turns the verse into an explicit contest of aligned backs.
The literal love, aid, and alliance repeats mawla in a context that makes its coalition force visible.
The literal opposition to corruption qualifies the wider alliance as restorative rather than merely stronger.

structural_cues: 66:4 opposes a two-person mutual backing to a named sequence of divine, angelic, and believing support centered on the repeated mawla.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heart-inclination, mutual backing, and the repeated mawla inside a counter-alliance; I infer that 66:2's release can function as allegiance realignment when an oath embodies intimate pressure. A live alternative confines 66:4's alliance language to defense of the prophet without generalizing it to oath governance.

changed_reading.before: 'God is your patron' reassures the oath-maker after release.
changed_reading.after: 'God is your patron' adjudicates rival alignments: discharge can remove an oath from a pressured local coalition and restore action to primary allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later possibility of divorce presents full release from the marital bond followed by replacement. Against that terminal mechanism, taḥilla becomes a less destructive reversibility: it can undo the oath before self-binding speech forces the relationship toward severance and substitution.

activation_trace.role: The literal loosening of a knot supplies a reversible release within an existing relation.
The literal oath-discharge locates that reversible mechanism in the focus command.
The literal release of the marriage bond supplies the more terminal form of unbinding against which taḥilla is measured.
The literal replacement of one thing by another marks the consequence after relational reversibility is exhausted.
The literal marital pairing keeps the release spectrum anchored in the same intimate field as the initiating problem.
The literal superior fitness makes replacement a genuine alternative, thereby increasing the urgency of earlier repair.

structural_cues: 66:5 moves in one clause from divorce to replacement spouses, making severance and substitution consecutive states.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oath-loosening in 66:2 and marital release plus replacement in 66:5; I infer a scale from reparative reversibility to terminal severance. The live alternative is that the later warning has no procedural relation to taḥilla.

changed_reading.before: Oath-discharge merely ends an unwanted commitment.
changed_reading.after: Oath-discharge is an early reversible intervention that can keep self-binding speech from driving an intimate bond toward full release and replacement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus offers a discharge in advance under divine prescription, whereas 66:7 rejects retrospective excuse and ties outcome to performed action. The contrast separates a lawful state-changing procedure from speech that merely attempts to evade an already realized consequence.

activation_trace.role: The literal defined imposition gives oath-release prior authorization and a determinate boundary.
The literal oath-discharge changes the binding state rather than merely describing regret.
The literal adjudication supplies the authority that distinguishes discharge from self-serving excuse.
The literal excuse supplies the rejected look-alike: words offered too late without changing the accountable act.
The literal matching of deed with recompense fixes the consequence that retrospective speech cannot dissolve.

structural_cues: 66:7 places the ban on excuse immediately before the restriction 'only what you were doing,' contrasting verbal defense with enacted accountability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an instituted discharge and later bars excuse at recompense; I infer a temporal and juridical distinction between authorized conversion before consequence and evasive speech after it. The alternative is that the two audiences and moments are too different for the contrast to define taḥilla.

changed_reading.before: Taḥilla is a divinely approved excuse for nonperformance.
changed_reading.after: Taḥilla is precisely not excuse: it is an authorized, timely act that changes an oath's state before accountability, while retrospective words do not.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root that denotes oaths in the focus reappears as right hands beside moving light. In a sequence of sincere repair, covering bad effects, forward motion, completion, and forgiveness, oath-discharge acquires a second kinetic image: releasing self-bound speech restores the right-side capacity by which light can advance. The oath and hand senses coexist rather than being lexically collapsed.

activation_trace.role: The literal loosening supplies the removal of an impediment from future movement.
The literal oath anchors the binding speech from which the kinetic reading departs.
The literal purity from admixture makes repentance a sincere repair rather than strategic oath avoidance.
The literal covering that effaces fault supplies removal of the oath episode's harmful residue.
The literal harmful effect names what must be cleared before restored agency can move.
The repeated literal illumination supplies the moving field through which restored agency becomes visible.
The literal right hand activates a bodily and directional counterpart to the focus root's oath sense.
The literal reaching of completion turns release into one stage of an unfinished forward process.
The literal covering of fault protects the moving subject from the released oath's lingering effects.

structural_cues: 66:8 places أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ beside light that strives forward and a request that the light be completed, creating an exact root echo with أَيْمَٰنِكُمْ in 66:2.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the oath/right-hand root echo and a sequence from sincere return through covering to moving and completed light; I infer that lawful unbinding clears obstructed right-side agency. The live alternative is ordinary polysemy with no conceptual transfer between oath and hand.

changed_reading.before: Discharging the oath only removes a backward-looking liability.
changed_reading.after: Discharge also restores forward capacity: the oath-sense of y-m-n is loosened so the coactivated right-hand sense can carry light toward completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two reversed households test the focus claim that God is patron. Proximity to righteous husbands cannot avail betrayal, while a believing woman inside a tyrant's house asks for a house near God and rescue by separation. Divine patronage is thus nontransferable and emancipatory; oath-discharge can relocate allegiance from a coercive household claim to nearness under the true patron.

activation_trace.role: The literal opening at an edge supplies an authorized exit from a binding social enclosure.
The literal displacement from a place turns unbinding into movement out of an imposed location.
The literal nearness without separation supplies the destination of the transferred allegiance.
The literal governance of an affair makes patronage effective jurisdiction rather than borrowed household status.
The literal deficiency of fidelity shows that marital proximity cannot transfer moral standing.
The literal sufficiency, negated in the verse, denies that a spouse can function as an adequate patron before God.
The literal construction by joining parts supplies the deliberate formation of an alternative belonging.
The literal presence near another makes nearness to God, rather than mere escape, the requested destination.
The literal dwelling supplies a replacement shelter under true patronage.
The repeated literal rescue by separation supplies the motion out of false household jurisdiction.
The literal withholding from a right identifies the coercive condition from which separation is needed.

structural_cues: 66:10 and 66:11 reverse marital configurations: a wife under a righteous man is not saved by proximity, while a righteous wife under a tyrant seeks a different house near God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed borrowed protection, requested nearness, a new dwelling, and repeated rescue by separation; I infer that 'God is your mawla' authorizes transfer out of false allegiance and that oath-discharge can enact that transfer. The live alternative keeps the two household examples eschatological and unrelated to the focus procedure.

changed_reading.before: Divine patronage supplements the protections already supplied by intimate relationships.
changed_reading.after: Divine patronage cannot be borrowed through a spouse and can oppose a household's claim; discharge may be the authorized exit that relocates allegiance near God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close distinguishes kinds of verbal binding. A human oath may require discharge, while divine words and writings are guarded, confirmed, and allowed to establish judgment. Binding force therefore comes not from speech alone but from source, authority, and fit with divine governance.

activation_trace.role: The literal human oath supplies the form of consequential speech that remains dischargeable.
The literal divinely fixed determination supplies the superior authority that can alter the oath's state.
The literal judgment between claims supplies the rule for ranking different verbal obligations.
The literal preservation within an enclosure supplies an integrity frame for receiving and keeping divine speech.
The literal realization of a word in action makes confirmation the response to authoritative promise.
The literal meaningful expression supplies the verbal material whose authority is being confirmed.
The literal inscription that establishes a judgment supplies durable divine norm in contrast to a self-authored oath.

structural_cues: 66:12 joins guarding, confirming divine words, confirming books, and sustained devotion in a single exemplary sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a dischargeable human oath in 66:2 and guarded confirmation of divine words and writings in 66:12; I infer a hierarchy in which source and authority, not verbal form alone, determine what must be released or confirmed. The live alternative treats Mary's confirmation as faith language with no contrast to oaths.

changed_reading.before: An oath binds because solemn words inherently control later action.
changed_reading.after: Speech has differentiated authority: self-authored solemn words can be discharged under divine judgment, while divine words are confirmed and enacted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it uses the packet's secondary ح ل ي mapping for the focus consonantal cue rather than the direct oath-discharge branch. It remains anchored in تَحِلَّةَ and converges with apportioned gift, blessing, and bestowed good, but downstream prose should present it only as an affective overlay, never as a replacement lexical gloss.

activation_trace.role: The literal ornament activates release as a re-clothing of agency after a constricting oath is removed.
The literal reception of good makes the discharge a positive benefit rather than a merely negative cancellation.
The literal apportioned gift supplies the mode by which the beneficial release is granted.
The literal blessing supplies the restored quality of action after discharge.
The literal bestowal of good makes the patron the giver of rehabilitative release.

changed_reading.before: Discharge only subtracts the burden of an oath.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, discharge also re-endows the person: an apportioned good re-clothes released agency with blessing under its patron.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-material activation from remote branch images: incision and untying in the focus meet stitching a rent and a piece that completes weaving in 66:8. It remains anchored in the focus's cut, knot, and exactness, but it should be rendered as a repair analogy, not as the lexical meaning of taḥilla or sincere repentance.

activation_trace.role: The literal cut supplies the tear-like breach created when obligation and action diverge.
The literal untying supplies controlled access to the damaged bond before it is repaired.
The literal secure workmanship makes restoration, not mere opening, the governing aim.
The literal stitching of a rent turns sincere return into the joining action that follows release.
The literal piece that completes a weaving supplies the repaired whole toward which discharge moves.

changed_reading.before: The oath is cut away and the episode ends.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the cut opens a damaged bond for stitching: discharge is one operation in restoring the fabric of action to wholeness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it projects the household fire imagery of 66:6 backward onto the focus's incision, aperture, knot, and bridle. It stays anchored in the focus's material branch sequence and in the explicit command to ward family from kindled fire, but downstream prose should qualify it as a preventive systems analogy rather than claim that the oath itself is fire.

activation_trace.role: The literal incision supplies a break that interrupts propagation through a binding structure.
The literal edge opening supplies a controlled escape path before pressure reaches a destructive state.
The literal loosening supplies early de-escalation inside the oath relation.
The literal bridle keeps preventive release disciplined rather than permissive.
The literal warding of harm supplies the preventive purpose for intervening before family conflict propagates.
The literal kindled fire supplies the terminal hazard against which controlled oath-release acts as a break.

changed_reading.before: Discharge relieves only the individual who swore.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, timely discharge is a household firebreak: a disciplined opening interrupts the spread of self-binding pressure before persons and relations become fuel.

strongest_changes: 66:1 turns generic expiation into repair of a self-prohibition produced under intimate approval pressure.
66:3 makes divine knowledge and wisdom a mechanism of selective disclosure: enough is exposed for repair, while some is deliberately passed over.
66:4 turns mawla from generic reassurance into the governing center of competing allegiances.
The y-m-n echo in 66:8 lets oath and right-hand senses coexist, recasting discharge as restoration of forward, light-bearing agency.
The reversed households of 66:10-11 make divine patronage nontransferable and potentially emancipatory rather than supplementary to marital status.
summary.what_was_special: The focus proved unusually productive at boundaries: cut yet opened, bound yet lawfully loosened, intimate yet governed by a nearer patron. Context repeatedly changed static legal permission into dynamic repair, realignment, selective revelation, restored movement, and relocation. The packet's split ح ل ل mapping also preserved a form-distant but coherent positive overlay of release as bestowed adornment or good.
remaining_uncertainties: The oath/right-hand transfer is supported by an exact root echo, but it may remain rhetorical coactivation rather than a designed causal model.
Selective disclosure in 66:3 may exemplify the focus epithets without directly specifying how oath-discharge works.
The scale from oath-loosening to marital severance is coherent in sequence but is supplied by reader inference rather than explicit comparison.
The textile, firebreak, and secondary ح ل ي readings are branch-backed and focus-anchored, yet remain deliberately exploratory material analogies.
